title: Office & Commercial Movers in Altadena | SOS Moving
metaDescription: Commercial movers in Altadena: office relocations staged around county curb permits, building COI and freight-lift windows, with clear hourly crew rates.
heroSubtitle: County curb permits, building COI and a staged schedule — handled by one crew

faq.question: Do we need a permit to park your truck at our Altadena curb?
faq.answer: It depends on what the truck has to do. Because the community is unincorporated, anything that closes a lane, occupies the road right-of-way or leaves a container at the curb runs through Los Angeles County Public Works and its EPIC-LA portal rather than a city counter. We name the permit your address needs at the walkthrough, before the date is fixed.

faq.question: Can you issue a certificate of insurance for our building?
faq.answer: Yes. A COI costs $50 and is written to the wording your property manager asks for, including the additional insured they name. Send the request across as soon as you have a date and we will have it with the management office ahead of move day.

faq.question: Is a Saturday or Sunday office move possible in Altadena?
faq.answer: Yes. Crews work Monday through Sunday between 8AM and 6PM, so a Saturday or Sunday booking is routine rather than a special arrangement. Larger offices are usually split across two weekends, with one department settled before the next one starts packing.

faq.question: How much does an office move in Altadena cost?
faq.answer: Two movers and a truck are $119 an hour in cash or $129 by card Monday through Thursday, and $135 or $145 Friday through Sunday; three- and four-mover crews are priced above that. There is a three-hour minimum, double drive time beyond 10 miles and a $50 deposit credited against the closing invoice. The firm number follows a walkthrough of both suites.

faq.question: Our building only opens on weekdays — does that change the plan?
faq.answer: It changes the staging rather than the rate. We take the access window from the management office, put the slow and heavy work inside it, and leave the light items for the end of the day. Where a landlord also wants the freight lift reserved, that slot is booked at the same time.

faq.question: Can you move heavy equipment and a piano out of our space?
faq.answer: Yes, with the right crew behind it. A single item over 300 lbs is moved by a three-mover crew for $150, and a piano is $200 and handled only by a crew of four. Mention those pieces at the walkthrough so the crew size and the truck are set correctly.
